description: Subscribe a URL to a form's new submissions: Fillout will POST each submission (same shape as a fillout_list_submissions entry) to it. Returns the webhook id — keep it, it is the only handle for removing the webhook later. Fillout: POST /webhook/create.

formId.description: The form's public id (the formId from fillout_list_forms, also the id in the form's share URL).

url.description: The HTTPS endpoint that should receive submissions.

name: fillout_create_webhook
title: Create a submission webhook
